name: Chihiros WRGB II Pro 60
description: Premium WRGB LED with per-channel programmable colour mixing via the Chihiros app and a Bluetooth remote. High-PAR output suitable for the most demanding red stem plants; usually run at 60-80% intensity to avoid burning carpet species at the surface. Chihiros publishes 6,630 lm and a 600 mm housing for this size; light.colorTempK and beamAngleDeg are omitted because the WRGB output is fully colour-mixable and no single CCT or beam figure is published.
